title: Function
description: One conditional distribution or simulator as a typed signature: outputs = f(inputs; attributes, parameters). Inputs are BN parents, attributes are fixed row data, parameters are the numbers shared by every row bound to one parameter set (an instance), whose shape is `instance_schema`. The function is replicated over the rows of its `per` plate.

role.description: Where it sits in the hazard -> consequence chain. Used for layout and for reading, not for wiring.

per.description: The plate: one instance of this function per row of this entity type.

attributes.description: Attributes of the `per` row the implementation reads. Checked to exist on the entity type and to be present on every bound row.

tables.description: Whole entity tables read as fixed structure, e.g. a network's topology. They are not BN nodes.

instance_schema.description: JSON Schema every instance of this function must satisfy: each parameter set's `values` under instances/<role>/, and the inline `parameters` of an assembly binding. Omit for a function with no parameters.

correlation_model.description: A model under schema/models/ whose parameter sets give the correlation between this joint function's rows. A binding names one with `correlation`; without it the rows are independent.

implementation.description: "python.module:Class": a tbnpy probability class, built for one binding by Class.from_spec(childs, parents, spec), whose childs are all its rows' outputs. See src/builder/kernels/__init__.py.

drawKind.description: Joint: one probability object draws its rows dependently. Marginal: rows are drawn independently given their parents; using it where a joint is needed silently imposes independence.

capabilities.description: Only what the implementation actually provides: each needs its method on the class (load.CAPABILITY_METHOD: SampleForward sample, EvaluateLikelihood log_prob, EvaluateDensity distribution), and the check reports a missing one as OVERCLAIM.

source.description: Provenance of the method (not of the numbers: those go on the parameter set).

quantity.description: A quantity id, or "{param}": the quantity named by that required parameter, whose values must all be quantity ids. A GMM declared with "{imt}" produces whichever intensity measure its parameter set says.

over.description: Plate the parent variable lives on.

via.description: Which rows of `over` are parents of one `per` row. self: the same row (over == per). <attr>: follow this foreign key on the per row, one parent. <Over>.<attr>: every `over` row whose foreign key <attr> points at this row, zero or more parents. *: every row of `over`.

quantity.description: A quantity id, or "{param}": the quantity named by that required parameter, whose values must all be quantity ids. A GMM declared with "{imt}" produces whichever intensity measure its parameter set says.
